cohort: The study included 48 patients with a history of cervical conization who underwent IVF/ICSI and a control group without cervical conization, all recruited from patients undergoing IVF/ICSI between 2009 and 2013.
finding: Cervical conization was not found to significantly affect IVF/ICSI outcomes, and there was no evidence that cervical stenosis impacted IVF operation.
